motion.name: camera-between-stops
motion.value: position: smoothstep 3t^2 - 2t^3 of fractional step; zoom: exp(lerp(log z0, log z1, t)); step = page scroll measured from stop centres to stage centre
motion.purpose: Scroll camera from street to lobby, floors, roof, station, platform.

motion.name: camera-framing
motion.value: desktop subject at 30% x / 50% y; mobile (<768px) at 50% x / 24% y
motion.purpose: Leaves room for the stop panel (right on desktop, bottom on phones).

motion.name: pointer-parallax
motion.value: ±34px x, ±10px y scaled by (1 - progress); ease 1 - exp(-2.6 dt); idle after 4s: x = sin(0.11t)*0.55, y = sin(0.07t + 1)*0.25
motion.purpose: Street-only pointer parallax and idle wander.

motion.name: street-fade
motion.purpose: Street overlays fade out and the HUD band fades in over the first ~45% of the first transition.

motion.name: elevator
motion.purpose: Glass car follows the scroll continuously; floors light as it passes.

motion.name: train-arrival
motion.value: a = clamp((progress - (platformStep - 1)) / 0.85); x offset (1 - (1 - a)^3) from trainLen + 400u; acid streaks at 0.06 * (1 - ease)
motion.purpose: Train brakes into the platform over the station-to-platform scroll; reverses on scroll back.

motion.name: doors
motion.value: open = clamp((time - arrived - 0.35s) / 0.7s); screen doors slide 28% of panel width; lamps cyan to acid and board ARRIVING to BOARDING past 0.5
motion.purpose: Train and platform screen doors open together on clock time once parked.

motion.name: power-on
motion.value: 900ms linear, once; opacity 0.18 at 0/8/20/34%, 1 at 4/14/26%, 0.55 at 40%, 1 from 46%
motion.purpose: Stop panel titles lighting the first time they scroll in (rootMargin -12% bottom).

motion.name: glitch-slice
motion.purpose: Hero name magenta/cyan slices on a user lightning strike.

motion.name: neon-failure
motion.value: every 4-15s: stutter 45% (0.25-0.7s, flicker 1/0.12), dropout 30% (70-210ms at 0.06), brownout 25% (0.4-1.2s at 0.48 ±0.05 at 60Hz)
motion.purpose: Canvas sign idle failures; rest at 0.6, chosen sign and the sign beside the floor being read at 1; chosen sign has a 3.2s scan band.

motion.name: selection-stutter
motion.value: 0.5s stutter; camera rides to the floor 480ms after choosing

motion.name: open-sign-fit
motion.value: top 60px; limit = name top - 14px; glyph = min(clamp(0.026W, 26, 40), (limit - top) / 1.5); dropped below 18px and below 768px
motion.purpose: OPEN sign fits itself above the hero name.

motion.name: rain-diagonal
motion.value: dx = 0.27 * dy; 3 depth passes at 0.28/0.38/0.5 alpha; density levels 0.32/0.62/1; x(0.35 + 0.65 * street) off the street; clipped out of the underground

motion.name: lightning-envelope
motion.value: pulses 1.0@0, 0.55@70ms, 0.85@200ms, each exp decay tau 65ms; bolt visible 340ms; user cooldown 1.2s; ambient every 14-32s (7-16s Monsoon) at 0.35 exp(-t/0.12) + 0.2 echo at 160ms
motion.purpose: User and ambient strikes lighting sky, skyline and street.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: camera snaps to nearest stop; parallax 35% at ease 1.5/s, no idle wander; signs, OPEN (0.9), station sign and fluorescents steady; train parked within half a step of the platform, doors open at once, no streaks, board status steady; rain 30% density, 55% speed; no ambient strikes; strike = single 0.45 flash (tau 350ms), no bolt, no glitch; ripple 1.5px; walkers/steam halved; power-on/glitch animation none; ticker 600s; scroll-behavior auto and instant in-page jumps

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Alley After Last Train"**

The whole page is one Seoul block at 1 a.m. in the rain, seen through one camera. The first viewport is the street: violet skyline, four towers with neon roof names (APPLIED AI, PRODUCT, PLAYGROUND, EXPERIENCE), vertical hangul signs hanging beside the floors they name, orange pojangmacha tents with walkers and steam, an OPEN sign with a dead N, a rippled reflection on the asphalt, diagonal rain and lightning on demand. Scrolling does not leave that street; it moves the camera into it. Each tower is a line of work and each floor a project, read through its window (screenshot, or the name lettered in neon) while a glass elevator rides the facade. The stack lights up as signs on masts over the roofs, then the camera goes down a lit stairwell to a cut-away subway platform where the last train brakes in, opens its doors, and the contact panel waits.

Every stop of the ride carries exactly one bracketed panel of near-black ink beside the subject, so the neon stays the only light and the light source is always the line's own colour. Display type is condensed uppercase Archivo at 62% width; on white type it carries a magenta/cyan chromatic split, on line-coloured type it glows as a tube. System chrome is ui-monospace in small tracked caps between corner brackets: the HUD, the elevator readout, codes, floors. Corners on the interface are square. Depth comes from glow, the reflection and the camera's own zoom, never from lifted cards.

Motion is the world's weather and machinery, not decoration: neon fails like old glass, rain falls on one diagonal, the camera eases between stops, the elevator follows the scroll, the train brakes in and its doors open. Panels themselves scroll in plain page flow and only power on. Every one of those motions has an implemented reduced-motion fallback.
keyCharacteristics: Ink-black ground (#05010f) with four towers: magenta applied AI, cyan product, acid playground, lilac experience; acid also lights the station.
Scroll is the camera: street → lobby → floors → roof → station → platform, one canvas behind a column of panels.
Condensed uppercase Archivo with chromatic aberration on white type; Gothic A1 Heavy for hangul sign lettering.
Monospace HUD voice in tracked caps framed by 10px corner brackets; the elevator readout (L / nF / R / B1 / B2) is the page's position.
Square interface geometry; light, not shadow, carries depth.
A single rain diagonal (dx = 0.27 · dy) everywhere it falls.

rules.name: The Tower Owns Its Light Rule
rules.body: Each tower has exactly one colour (AI magenta, product cyan, playground acid, experience lilac). Every surface that belongs to a tower (roof name, lobby glow, floor window outline, hangul sign, panel top edge, title tube, floor number, stack ticks, link underline, readout glow) takes that colour and nothing else. The one override is hot: the current role is lit magenta.

rules.name: The Only Light Rule
rules.body: Grounds are ink; colour appears only as emitted light (glow, tube text, hairline, pip). No neon-tinted panel fills except the three solid-fill devices: the solid tube button, the NOW badge, the NEWSWIRE label.

rules.name: The World Lights Stay In The World Rule
rules.body: Tent orange and LED amber belong to the canvas. They never become a tower colour or a UI accent.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Condensed caps for anything that is a sign; tracked monospace caps for anything that is instrumentation. Body Archivo carries reading only. No third display voice.

rules.name: The Chroma Is For White Type Rule
rules.body: The magenta/cyan split (±0.045em) sits on white display and headline type; the ±1.5px cut only on the JG mark. Tower-coloured titles glow as tubes instead and never get chroma.

rules.name: The Names Keep Their Case Rule
rules.body: Brand words with a lowercase tail after two or more capitals (OPIc) keep their casing inside uppercase styles and in canvas lettering.

rules.name: The One Panel Per Stop Rule
rules.body: Every stop of the ride carries exactly one panel beside the subject the camera is framing. Lists inside a panel are hairline rows or the wire-gridded floor directory; never card grids.

rules.name: The Camera Not The Content Rule
rules.body: Movement between stops belongs to the canvas camera. The panels scroll at page speed and never slide, fade or parallax on their own.

rules.name: The Emitted Not Cast Rule
rules.body: Every shadow is light leaving a tube in its own colour. A dark offset shadow has no source on this street.

dos: Do give every surface of a tower its single colour: magenta AI, cyan product, acid playground, lilac experience; light the current role magenta.
Do put new content on the ride as a stop: a camera key on the canvas plus one panel beside it.
Do set signs, names and titles in condensed uppercase Archivo (62% width, 800, 0.88 line-height), and hangul sign lettering in Gothic A1 Heavy.
Do put all instrumentation in the 0.6875rem monospace label voice with 0.14em tracking and tabular numerals.
Do draw interface frames with 1px inset rings, 10px corner brackets and wire hairlines; keep every interface corner square.
Do express depth as emitted glow in the element's own colour, on ink grounds.
Do keep the rain on the 0.27 diagonal everywhere it appears.
Do ship a reduced-motion branch for every new moving thing, and pause the canvas off screen and in hidden tabs.
donts: Don't add rounded corners, opaque filled cards or card grids, or dark offset drop shadows to the interface; panels are translucent ink with drawn frames.
Don't use tent orange, LED amber or any fifth accent on UI chrome or text.
Don't put chroma on tower-coloured tube titles or on body text.
Don't animate panels on their own (no slides, fades or content parallax); the camera moves, panels only power on.
Don't let HUD and panels collide: anything that stays on screen during the ride sits in the HUD layer above the band.
Don't set hangul in the condensed Latin cut without its Korean tracking and line-height overrides.
